title: Major opening to the primary living space oriented north-west to east with a 3 m x 3 m uncovered area
text: Orientation of major openings (applies to R50-R80; R100-SL; LR, MR, and HR only). Note: No orientation provisions apply to primary living areas located in climate zones 1 and 3. C2.2.2 For single houses(1) in climate zones 4,5 and 6, a major opening to the primary living space is oriented between north-west and east in accordance with Figure 2.2b, with an adjoining uncovered open area with: i. a minimum dimension 3m x 3m(2) in accordance with Figure 2.2c; and ii. the exception of shading devices up to 2m depth. (1) Until 10 April 2030, this provision does not apply to single houses located in areas designated with a residential density code of R50 or higher within a structure plan and/or local development plan that was approved prior to 10 April 2024. (2) The centre line of the minimum 3m x 3m area must be contained within the glazed area of the major opening (Figure 2.2d).

parts.label: major opening oriented between north-west and east (Figure 2.2b)

exceptions.label: transitional: R50 or higher site within a structure plan or LDP approved before 10 April 2024 (until 10 April 2030)

replaces.note: provision and transitional footnote identical to Vol 1 v3

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Scope comes only from the heading (R50-R80; R100-SL; LR, MR, HR); the clause body names no code. Note on p17: no orientation provisions apply in climate zones 1 and 3. The uncovered area is measured with shading devices up to 2 m deep disregarded (C2.2.2(ii)) and its centre line must sit within the glazed area of the opening (footnote 2, Figure 2.2d); area >= 9m2 is the 3 m x 3 m square. The transitional exception expires 10 April 2030; the engine has no date fact, so the applicant answers the proposed boolean for the assessment date. Register: ToC says transition 'extended' and that R40-and-below arrangements will be considered, but the draft scopes to R50+ only.
